story: Denver Radically Expanded Its Transit, So Why Are More People Driving Cars?
text: Even reducing the number of free parking spots would help. IMHO free parking isn't actually free: [VIDEO] . The company I work for is building a large new parking structure in my office because people have complained about parking for so long. Do they offer transit options? No. It seems shortsighted. EDIT: I see you are being downvoted. I assume that's because of your "charge tolls" recommendation. Most folks I talk to think they "pay their fare share" with taxes and roads. They are surprised that road and gas taxes only pay for about half: [LINK]
